members.description: Family-owned café serving home-style breakfast, wood-fired lunches, and locally roasted Kisoro Coffee since 2012.
Full-service design studio helping local businesses with branding, websites, signage, and community-focused print campaigns.
Guided hiking tours, camping gear, and outdoor apparel specializing in trips around Lake Mutanda and the Virunga foothills.
Personal, farm, and small-business insurance with local Kisoro-based claims adjusters and bilingual customer support.
Community gym with daily group classes, personal training, youth sports camps, and a weekend mountain-running club.
Independent bookstore and community reading space with a curated section of Ugandan authors and local-history titles.
Primary-care clinic offering family medicine, outpatient wellness, childhood vaccinations, and after-hours urgent care in Kisoro.
